svg.title: Dragon Database Silver and Black Logo Concepts
svg.desc: Four silver-and-black dragon logos with black flames, medieval swords, and original black fantasy lettering on silver backgrounds: Blackflame, Swordmaw, Silverblade, and Ashcrown.

g.font-family: Avenir Next, Avenir, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.title: Dragon Database — DB Blackflame
svg.desc: A silver-and-black dragon DB emblem with flames or medieval sword details, paired with original black path lettering spelling Dragon Database on a silver background. The lettering has uneven fantasy proportions, pointed medieval terminals, and a sword underline.

g.font-family: Avenir Next, Avenir, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

Original fantasy lettering with a sword underline.
